title: Rajamouli's Varanasi Reportedly Sets Record Telugu Theatrical Deal
excerpt: Trade reports put the Telugu-states deal for the Mahesh Babu film at Rs. 290-300 crore, above RRR's reported Rs. 225 crore, with official confirmation still awaited ahead of the April 7, 2027 release.
body:
• SS Rajamouli's Telugu film Varanasi, starring Mahesh Babu, has reportedly closed its Telugu-states theatrical deal — reported at Rs. 300 crore by 123Telugu and Rs. 290 crore by other trade outlets, with official confirmation still awaited.
  • Either reported figure would surpass the roughly Rs. 225 crore Telugu-states deal reported for Rajamouli's RRR.
  • The cast includes Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Prithviraj Sukumaran and Prakash Raj, with music by MM Keeravaani.
  • Varanasi is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on April 7, 2027, in multiple languages; diaspora readers will watch it in theatres on that date.

Varanasi, the Telugu-language film from RRR director SS Rajamouli starring Mahesh Babu, has reportedly set a new benchmark for pre-release theatrical business in the Telugu states — though trade reports differ on the exact price and the deal has not yet been officially confirmed.

According to 123Telugu, Mythri Movie Distributors LLP has acquired the Telugu theatrical rights for Rs. 300 crore, and Netflix has reportedly acquired the digital rights. Other trade reporting puts the figure lower: Sacnilk, citing TrackTollywood, reported Rs. 290 crore for the Andhra Pradesh and Telangana rights, and Telugu360 also reported Rs. 290 crore. Sacnilk noted that an official confirmation from the parties involved is still awaited.

How it compares with RRR

On either reported figure, the deal would exceed the benchmark set by Rajamouli's previous film. Sacnilk reported that RRR's Telugu-states theatrical rights were valued at around Rs. 225 crore, and that Varanasi would require approximately Rs. 500 crore in gross collections from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana alone for distributors to break even, because distributors recover their investment through their share of box-office revenue rather than the full gross. Sacnilk also reported that the agreement followed competition among leading distributors, with earlier trade discussions seeing offers exceeding Rs. 275 crore.

The film

Varanasi is a Telugu film presented as a globetrotting spectacle. Mahesh Babu plays the lead, with Prithviraj Sukumaran, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Prakash Raj and others in key roles, according to 123Telugu. Oscar-winning composer MM Keeravaani is composing the music. 123Telugu reported the film is produced under the Sri Durga Arts and Showing Business banners, while Telugu360 reported it is produced by KL Narayana and said the pending shoots will be completed before the end of this year.

Where the production stands

Telugu360 reported that Varanasi is in the final stages of shooting, that the makers are currently closing all the deals, and that the film's business is expected to be closed before the end of this year. Sacnilk reported that distributor confidence rests on Rajamouli's track record: his Baahubali 2 and RRR demonstrated exceptional theatrical potential in the Telugu states, and Mahesh Babu's established following in those states adds to the film's commercial appeal. That combination — a director whose last two films set the market's ceiling and a star with a large home-state following — is the trade logic the reported price rests on, even before an official announcement confirms the final number.

When and where to watch

The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres worldwide on April 7, 2027, in multiple languages, according to 123Telugu. Telugu360 reported that theatrical rights for other territories are still being closed, and that Rajamouli is negotiating with digital platforms on the digital rights and is in touch with international studios for the English and non-Indian release. No streaming date has been announced in the sources read.
nri_angle: Telugu diaspora audiences get a dated worldwide theatrical release — April 7, 2027 — for Rajamouli and Mahesh Babu's first film together.
author: Diaspora Desk
